title: Business Gates
subtitle: Gates G0–G7 with their criteria, evidence, decisions and exceptions. Each gate passes only on the server's evaluation.
taskHint: Task completion never unlocks a gate: a gate passes only with evidence accepted by the criterion reviewer, approved exceptions and a final authorized decision.
counts: {met} met · {waived} waived · {na} not applicable · of {total} criteria

blockers.title: Blockers
blockers.none: No blockers — the criteria and prerequisites are satisfied.
blockers.decision: No final authorized decision backs this gate

reassessment.title: Controlled reassessment requested
reassessment.body: Evidence relied upon for {criteria} is now conflicting. The approval of this cycle is preserved; an authorized person decides whether to reopen the gate as a new cycle.
reassessment.upstream: Upstream gate approval under reassessment: {gates}. Review whether this gate still stands.

actions.approverOnly: Only the gate approver ({role}) records this decision.

start.title: Start assessment — {gate}
start.effect: The current cycle moves to In assessment; criteria can be worked on.
start.parallel: Starting an assessment does not require prerequisite gates to be approved (preparation may run in parallel).

markReady.title: Submit for decision — {gate}
markReady.effect: The cycle moves to Ready for decision; the server re-checks every criterion, evidence and prerequisite now.
markReady.notReady: The server will refuse: {count} blocker(s) remain.
markReady.frozen: Criteria are frozen until the gate is sent back to assessment.

back.title: Back to assessment — {gate}
back.effect: The cycle returns to In assessment so criteria can change.

link.title: Link governance decision — {gate}
link.effect: The chosen committee decision is linked to this cycle.
link.blocked: A recommendation pending external authority, or any decision that is not finally approved, keeps the gate blocked.

decide.title: Gate decision — {gate}

effect.approve: The gate is approved for this cycle.
effect.approve_with_exceptions: The gate is approved with its recorded waivers visible as exceptions.
effect.reject: The gate is rejected for this cycle.

decide.recheck: The server re-evaluates criteria, evidence and prerequisites at decision time.
decide.finalOnly: An approval needs a final governance decision: approved within mandate, or approved by the authorized body.

reopen.title: Controlled reopen — {gate}
reopen.effect: A new assessment cycle {cycle} is created in status Reopened.
reopen.preserved: Cycle {cycle}, its status, decision and evidence snapshot are preserved unchanged.
reopen.newDecision: Passing the gate again requires a fresh review and a new final decision.
reopen.resetHint: Selected criteria start the new cycle as Unmet; criteria with conflicting evidence start as Conflicting.

decide.decisionHint: Decisions raised for this gate and visible committee decisions. The server checks that it is final and belongs to this project.

decision.title: Governance decision
decision.none: No decision is linked to the current cycle.
decision.notVisible: A decision is linked but you cannot view it.
decision.final: Final authorized decision — it can back the gate approval.
decision.notFinal: Not a final authorized decision — the gate stays blocked.
decision.rule: The gate is decided by the {role}, who must not be the person who submitted it.

criteria.title: Criteria
criteria.hint: Mandatory criteria must be met with evidence accepted by the reviewer, waived by an approved waiver (only if waivable) or determined not applicable by the reviewer role.

criterion.frozen: Criteria of this cycle cannot change in its current state.

na.pending: Not applicable — proposed, awaiting determination by the {role}. It does not count until approved.

evidence.title: Evidence (Document & Evidence Center)
evidence.unavailable: Evidence is not available to you.

cycles.title: Assessment cycles
cycles.hint: A reopen creates a new cycle; earlier cycles and their decisions are never modified.

waivers.title: Exceptions register (waivers)
waivers.hint: Every waiver records its basis, impact, approver authority and decision. Non-waivable criteria refuse waivers.

evidence.title: Add evidence — {criterion}
evidence.effect: The evidence is linked to the criterion in the Document & Evidence Center.
evidence.unverified: It stays unverified until reviewed by someone other than you.
evidence.documentHint: Only documents you can read are listed.

submit.title: Submit evidence — {criterion}
submit.effect: The criterion moves to Evidence submitted (active evidence is required).
submit.reviewer: The {role} reviews it; you cannot accept your own evidence.

met.title: Accept as met — {criterion}
met.effect: The criterion is recorded as Met in this cycle.
met.rules: Refused if there is no active evidence, if evidence conflicts, or if you added the evidence yourself.

return.title: Return as unmet — {criterion}
return.effect: The criterion returns to Unmet and blocks the gate if it is mandatory.

proposeNa.title: Propose not applicable — {criterion}
proposeNa.effect: The criterion is proposed as not applicable with your basis.
proposeNa.determination: It keeps blocking the gate until the {role} (not you) approves the determination.

approveNa.title: Approve not applicable — {criterion}
approveNa.effect: The specialist determination is recorded and the criterion stops blocking.
approveNa.rules: Only the {role} may determine it, and not the proposer.

rejectNa.title: Reject not applicable — {criterion}
rejectNa.effect: The proposal is rejected and the criterion returns to Unmet.

waiver.title: Request waiver — {criterion}
waiver.effect: A waiver request is sent for approval by the {role}.
waiver.nonWaivable: This criterion is non-waivable: the server refuses and logs the request, and the criterion stays unmet.
waiver.nonWaivableWarning: Specialists determined that this criterion is non-waivable. An exception cannot override it; a request will be refused and logged.
waiver.notSelf: You cannot approve your own waiver.
waiver.impactHint: Schedule, cost, risk and transaction impact.

waivability.title: Waivability determination — {criterion}
waivability.waivable: The criterion becomes waivable; waivers need approval by the {role}.
waivability.nonWaivable: The criterion becomes non-waivable; pending waivers can no longer be approved.
waivability.versioned: The determination is versioned; the previous one stays in the history.
waivability.basisHint: Name the specialist assessment behind this determination.

approveWaiver.title: Approve waiver — {criterion}
approveWaiver.effect: The criterion is recorded as Waived in this cycle and the gate shows the exception.
approveWaiver.rules: Only the {role} may approve, never the requester, and only while the criterion is waivable.

rejectWaiver.title: Reject waiver — {criterion}
rejectWaiver.effect: The waiver is rejected and the criterion stays as it is.

dimensions.independent: Each dimension moves on its own evidence; one being complete never completes the carve-out.
dimensions.explanationLanguage: The computed explanation is provided by the server in English.
dimensions.complete: All dimensions have reached their terminal state.
dimensions.notComplete: The carve-out is not complete: other dimensions are still pending.
dimensions.registerUnavailable: The contributing register is not available to you.
dimensions.recomputeEffect: The four dimensions are recomputed from the registers now; changes are versioned.
